system.description: By touching an animal, spending a Willpower Trait, and winning a Mental Challenge, you make contact with its mind; a Simple Test per memory lets you read one memory, with failure breaking contact. Spending a full minute and another Willpower Trait plus a second Mental Challenge instead forges a permanent bond, granting at-will access to all the animal's memories without further contact until you choose to end it; failing the ongoing Simple Test only costs a turn's delay, and prolonged bonding risks bleeding the animal's behavior patterns into the vampire.
